```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6
)

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
```

```{r load-data}
dengue_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/USER/class_r/CIS/National_extract_V1_3_1.csv")

world_dengue <- dengue_data %>%
  filter(case_definition_standardised == "Total")

world_dengue_2024 <- world_dengue %>%
  filter(Year == 2024)

world_dengue_total <- world_dengue_2024 %>%
  group_by(full_name, ISO_A0) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cases = sum(dengue_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_cases = log10(total_cases + 1)
  )
```

## 1. Worldwide 3D Choropleth Globe (Raw Cases)

```{r globe-raw}
plot_ly(
  data = world_dengue_total,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~ISO_A0,
  locationmode = "ISO-3",
  z = ~total_cases,
  text = ~paste(
    "Country:", full_name,
    "<br>Dengue Cases:", total_cases
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = "YlOrRd",
  colorbar = list(title = "Dengue Cases"),
  marker = list(
    line = list(color = "black", width = 0.3)
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Worldwide Distribution of Dengue Cases - 2024",
    geo = list(
      projection = list(
        type = "orthographic",
        rotation = list(lon = 0, lat = 0)
      ),
      showland = TRUE,
      landcolor = "grey90",
      showocean = TRUE,
      oceancolor = "lightblue",
      showcountries = TRUE,
      countrycolor = "black",
      showcoastlines = TRUE,
      coastlinecolor = "black",
      bgcolor = "white"
    )
  )
```

## 2. Customized 3D Choropleth Globe (Log Scale)

```{r globe-log}
max_cases <- max(world_dengue_total$total_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
case_breaks <- pretty(c(0, max_cases), n = 6)
case_breaks <- case_breaks[case_breaks >= 0 & case_breaks <= max_cases]
case_breaks <- sort(unique(c(0, case_breaks)))

p <- plot_ly(
  data = world_dengue_total,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~ISO_A0,
  locationmode = "ISO-3",
  z = ~log_cases,
  zmin = 0,
  zmax = max(world_dengue_total$log_cases, na.rm = TRUE),
  text = ~paste(
    "<b>Country:</b>", full_name,
    "<br><b>Dengue Cases:</b>", scales::comma(total_cases)
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = "YlOrRd",
  reversescale = FALSE,
  colorbar = list(
    title = list(text = "Dengue Cases"),
    tickvals = log10(case_breaks + 1),
    ticktext = scales::comma(case_breaks),
    thickness = 18,
    len = 0.65,
    tickfont = list(size = 11, color = "#4e4d47"),
    titlefont = list(size = 13, color = "#4e4d47")
  ),
  marker = list(
    line = list(color = "white", width = 0.4)
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "<b>Worldwide Distribution of Dengue Cases</b>",
        "<br><sup>Geographical distribution of reported dengue cases in 2024</sup>"
      ),
      x = 0.05,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(size = 21, color = "#4e4d47")
    ),
    geo = list(
      projection = list(
        type = "orthographic",
        rotation = list(lon = 0, lat = 0)
      ),
      showland = TRUE,
      landcolor = "#e6e6e1",
      showocean = TRUE,
      oceancolor = "#dcecf2",
      showcountries = TRUE,
      countrycolor = "white",
      showcoastlines = TRUE,
      coastlinecolor = "#999999",
      bgcolor = "#f5f5f2"
    ),
    paper_bgcolor = "#f5f5f2",
    plot_bgcolor = "#f5f5f2",
    margin = list(l = 10, r = 30, t = 90, b = 50),
    annotations = list(
      list(
        text = paste(
          "Note: Colour intensity represents reported dengue cases.",
          "A logarithmic transformation is used to improve visual comparison.",
          "Grey countries have no mapped observation."
        ),
        x = 0.02,
        y = -0.08,
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        xanchor = "left",
        font = list(size = 10, color = "#4e4d47")
      )
    )
  )

p
```

```{r prepare-sf}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

world_dengue_sf <- left_join(
  world,
  world_dengue_total,
  by = c("iso_a3" = "ISO_A0")
) %>%
  mutate(log_cases = log10(total_cases + 1))
```

## 3. Base World Map (`sf`)

```{r map-base-world}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world)
```

## 4. Basic Worldwide Dengue Choropleth

```{r map-choropleth-basic}
ggplot(world_dengue_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = total_cases))
```

## 5. Customized Worldwide Dengue Choropleth

```{r map-choropleth-custom}
ggplot(world_dengue_sf) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = total_cases),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightyellow",
    high = "darkred",
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Dengue Cases",
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Worldwide Distribution of Dengue Cases",
    subtitle = "Reported dengue cases in 2024",
    caption = "Source: Dengue dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 6. Logarithmic Worldwide Dengue Choropleth

```{r map-choropleth-log}
ggplot(world_dengue_sf) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = log_cases),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightyellow",
    high = "darkred",
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Log10 Cases"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Worldwide Distribution of Dengue Cases",
    subtitle = "Logarithmic transformation of reported cases, 2024"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 7. World Map Using Robinson Projection

```{r map-robinson}
ggplot(world_dengue_sf) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = log_cases),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightyellow",
    high = "darkred",
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Log10 Cases"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = "+proj=robin +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Worldwide Dengue Distribution - 2024"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 8. Worldwide Dengue Bubble Map

```{r map-bubble}
world_points <- world_dengue_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_cases)) %>%
  st_transform(8857) %>%
  st_point_on_surface()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = st_transform(world, 8857),
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_points,
    aes(size = total_cases),
    color = "red",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 10,
    name = "Dengue Cases",
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Worldwide Distribution of Dengue Cases",
    subtitle = "Bubble size represents reported dengue cases, 2024"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 9. Labelled Worldwide Dengue Bubble Map

```{r map-bubble-labelled}
world_labels <- world_points %>%
  mutate(
    coordinates = st_coordinates(geometry),
    longitude = coordinates[, 1],
    latitude = coordinates[, 2]
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = st_transform(world, 8857),
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_points,
    aes(size = total_cases),
    color = "red",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = world_labels,
    aes(
      x = longitude,
      y = latitude,
      label = name
    ),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 9,
    name = "Dengue Cases",
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Worldwide Dengue Cases by Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
